title: Terminal and Archive
author: Quentin Delacroix
blurb: Ansel Dravenmoor, a pilot bonded to an AI that lies, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
